in_marathi.name: Uditha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Uditha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Uditha means 'one who rises' or 'one who uplifts'. This name is often given to babies born during the rising of the sun or when the family is experiencing a new beginning or revival.

in_bengali.name: Uditha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Rising, Uplifting
in_bengali.long_meaning: Uditha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Uditha means 'one who rises' or 'one who uplifts'. This name is often given to babies born during the rising of the sun or when the family is experiencing a new beginning or revival.
